subject: PO requirements, invoice cadence, and discount structure for Aurora Labs
messages:
From: Elena Morris <procurement@auroralabs.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@auroralabs.com
Date: 2026-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO requirements / invoice cadence / discount tiers for Aurora Labs

Hi Rishi,

We're finalizing procurement requirements for the Redwood engagement and need to confirm a few things before issuing a PO:

- PO fields required by Aurora: PO Number, Billing Entity (Aurora Labs Inc - TaxID 12-3456789), BU Code, GL Account, Project Code, and Redwood SOW ID.
- Net terms: Aurora's default is net60. We can consider net30 with an early-pay discount; do you have a standard early-pay discount schedule?
- Invoice cadence: Aurora prefers consolidated monthly invoices. Some internal teams can accept weekly statements for high-volume integrations — is Redwood able to support both? Any minimum invoice threshold?
- Line-item mapping: We need a sample invoice showing line-item SKU mapping for usage-based billing (token/embedding usage broken out by product_code and region).
- Discounts/packaging: Please share standard volume/commit discount matrix. We have a $250k ARR commit band we're evaluating.

Attached is our PO template for your billing team to review.

Thanks,

Elena Morris
Procurement Manager
Aurora Labs
[Attachment: Aurora_PO_Template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <procurement@auroralabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements / invoice cadence / discount tiers for Aurora Labs

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Quick responses and a couple of tradeoffs to consider: 

1) PO fields: We can accept Aurora's template as long as the PO includes a Redwood SOW ID and a Billing Contact (name + email). For automated matching in our billing system we also need the PO Number and the Billing Entity (as you listed). If you can add an optional "product_code" column we can map line-items automatically; otherwise manual mapping adds processing time.

2) Net terms / early-pay: Our standard public terms are net60 for procurement-led deals. We can offer an early-pay incentive: 1.5% discount if paid within 30 days (net30), or 2.5% for net14. If Aurora prefers to lock a larger discount, we can structure a commit-based rebate instead (see next).

3) Invoice cadence: Monthly consolidated invoices are our default and easiest to support. We can do weekly statements for high-volume partners, but weekly requires a minimum invoice processing fee and a $25k monthly minimum volume for automation to make sense.

4) Discount & packaging options:
   - Commit tiers: 5% at $250k ARR, 8% at $500k ARR, 12% at $1.25M ARR (applies to usage and generation tokens).
   - Prepay model: upfront credit purchase with an additional 3% prepay bonus credit.
   - Custom bundle: fixed monthly seat + overage tokens model for steady-state workloads.

I've attached our PO guidelines and a simple discount matrix to make the tradeoffs explicit. Examples: if Aurora signs to the $250k ARR tier and elects monthly consolidated billing + net60, discount applies after the first full billing month. Early-pay discounts are applied on the invoice subtotal before tax.

Next steps I propose: Vanessa (cc'd) — can you run this on the billing side and confirm any ERP mapping constraints?

If Aurora wants to proceed with net30 + 1.5% for faster payment, we can reflect that in an amendment to the SOW. Otherwise we can proceed with standard net60 + commit rebate. Happy to jump on a short call to walk through an example invoice.

Best,

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_PO_Guidelines.pdf]
[Attachment: Discount_matrix.csv]

From: Elena Morris <procurement@auroralabs.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@auroralabs.com
Date: 2026-06-26T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements / invoice cadence / discount tiers for Aurora Labs

Rishi — thanks, that all helps. A couple of follow-ups:

- For the commit tiers, does the ARR threshold look at committed spend or billed spend? We'd prefer committed (contractual) for budget certainty.
- Can you share a sample invoice (line-item breakdown) so our AP team can validate the mapping against our ERP? If you have an example that shows token usage by product_code + region that would be perfect.
- Tax handling: Aurora has an EU entity for a portion of spend; please confirm whether Redwood can bill the EU entity directly or if tax will be applied to the US entity invoice.

We'll review the Redwood attachments internally — I'll have AP try a mock PO in our system and flag any mapping errors.

Regards,
Elena

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-26T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements / invoice cadence / discount tiers for Aurora Labs

Elena — quick answers inline and a proposal for next steps.

- Commit tiers: we calculate eligibility based on committed ARR in the agreement (not billed spend). We'll reflect that language in the SOW amendment so accounting has a clear trigger.
- Sample invoice: here's a link to a redacted sample invoice showing token/embedding line-items by product_code and region: https://drive.google.com/example/sample-invoice-aurora (also in related_links). If you prefer, Vanessa can export a CSV that matches Aurora's PO template for a dry-run.
- Tax: Redwood can invoice the EU entity directly; we'll need the EU VAT number on the PO and on our invoice to zero-rate VAT where applicable. Vanessa — can you confirm any ERPs we should be aware of for EU billing?

Proposed next steps:
1) Vanessa to run a mapping dry-run against Aurora_PO_Template.xlsx and return a mapped CSV.
2) Aurora to issue a draft PO with Redwood SOW ID and Billing Contact; if Aurora wants net30 w/1.5% early-pay we can accept that and reflect in the amendment.
3) If the $250k commit is the likely path, we'll issue an amendment showing the 5% rebate starting after month 1 post-activation.

If that works for you, I can schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow with Vanessa and Grace to walk the AP team through a sample invoice and the PO fields.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_v2.pdf]
